boundary: AES-256-CCM with additional authenticated data, tag 8 bytes, nonce 13 bytes
why: code/groups/SPEC.md binds the cleartext header as AAD. Our CCM had no AAD support at all, and the committed AES-256-CCM vectors all use EMPTY aad -- so adding AAD would have been validated only by its own round trip, which cannot catch an encrypt and decrypt that are wrong in the same way. These come from elsewhere.

provenance.note: Independent implementation, not ours. The 14-byte AAD case is the exact shape the groups bundle uses: header[0..12] + (header[12] & 0xF8) + header[13].
